message.text:
q24.

The chain runs from the React Query mutation hook through the Connect-RPC client, over the `memos.api.v1.MemoService/CreateMemo` procedure, into the Connect handler adapter, then the API service method, the store facade, and finally the dialect driver that emits the `INSERT INTO memo ... RETURNING id` statement.

```
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts        (useCreateMemo → memoServiceClient.createMemo)
web/src/connect.ts                     (memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport), line 197)
proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto        (rpc CreateMemo(CreateMemoRequest) returns (Memo), line 21)
server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go  (ConnectServiceHandler.CreateMemo, line 306 → APIV1Service.CreateMemo)
server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go   (APIV1Service.CreateMemo, line 70 → s.Store.CreateMemo)
store/memo.go                          (Store.CreateMemo, line 109 → s.driver.CreateMemo)
store/db/sqlite/memo.go                (DB.CreateMemo, line 16; SQL INSERT at line 41)
```

Notes on a couple of hops:

- The generated Connect stubs in `proto/gen/api/v1/apiv1connect/memo_service.connect.go` (and the TS message types in `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`) sit between the client and handler as generated glue rather than hand-written hops.
- The dialect driver shown is SQLite; the equivalent implementations are `store/db/postgres/memo.go` and `store/db/mysql/memo.go`, both dispatched through the `store.Driver` interface declared in `store/driver.go`.
